news.title: AI与倍数：AI如何重写私募股权价值创造Playbook
news.snippet: AI技术正在重塑PE行业价值创造策略，通过提升运营效率重构企业估值Multiple模型，改变传统Buyout逻辑。
news.raw_snippet: # AI and the Multiple: How AI Is Rewriting the Private Equity Value-Creation Playbook. Here is how artificial intelligence now moves the number that decides an exit, and why the window to build it is open right now. * Buyers are repricing in real time. Deal advisors are telling owners that multiples are softening for software and services businesses that are not generating AI intellectual property. * AI moves enterprise value through three levers: it drives cost out, it shifts a business into the tech-enabled category, and it builds proprietary IP the company owns at exit. * The third lever is the one most firms miss, and it is where the durable premium sits. Investment bankers and deal advisors are telling founders and CEOs a version of the same thing: the multiple is softening for any software or services business that is not generating artificial intelligence as part of what it does.

news.title: AI融资：真正的转折点 - Bertrand Duperrin
news.snippet: 探讨AI Funding是否进入理性回归阶段，从疯狂炒作转向实际应用价值评估的关键Turning Point，预示市场成熟度提升。
news.raw_snippet: We know we have a technology in our hands that can—and indeed will—revolutionize the world; that is no longer in question. Because the question on everyone’s mind isn’t whether AI can create value for its stakeholders and users, but whether **it can create enough value so that everyone benefits financially**, whether, ultimately, it will justify the hundreds of billions invested in this technological race, and, above all, when. At first glance, these are topics that mainly interest investors, but I wonder if they aren’t telling us something much more fundamental about the sector and an ecosystem that is gradually reaching a point where **the question is no longer just how much to invest, but who is still willing to do so**, under what conditions, and for how long. * *The debate is shifting: it no longer focuses primarily on AI’s performance or potential, but rather on the cost of capital, the time required to reach profitability, and investors’ willingness to continue funding this transition phase.*.

news.title: 当AI成为估值指标：金融服务的新竞争分水岭
news.snippet: AI能力正成为金融机构估值的核心Metric，在Debt Collection等细分领域，AI技术储备直接决定公司Market Value与竞争力。
news.raw_snippet: For debt collection agencies, debt buyers, creditors, collection law firms, and fintech leaders, this shift matters because AI adoption is beginning to influence how organizations are evaluated by clients, investors, buyers, and strategic partners. In that sense, AI-driven industry bifurcation and M&A are becoming closely connected. It is about which organizations can convert technology into measurable operational improvements, stronger margins, better governance and compliance, and more scalable business models. In that case, the next competitive advantage in financial services will belong to organizations that understand AI as a strategic capability rather than a narrow software deployment. AI-driven industry bifurcation and M&A describe a growing divide between companies that are actively using AI to improve business performance and those that are still evaluating whether to act. A business with strong revenue but limited technology infrastructure may not be viewed the same way as a company with comparable revenue, scalable workflows, clean data architecture, and a clear AI deployment roadmap.

news.title: Yann LeCun致力于开发更灵活的AI系统
news.snippet: Meta首席AI科学家指出当前AI"并不聪明"，正研发具备更高Flexibility和推理能力的新一代AI架构，突破现有LLM局限性。
news.raw_snippet: # AI is 'not smart' so what's next in artificial intelligence? "We don't have robots that are nearly as good at understanding the physical world as a rat," says Yann LeCun, one of the leading figures in the world of artificial intelligence. He worked at Facebook-owner, Meta, for a decade, where he was chief AI scientist, but left in 2025 and founded Advanced Machine Intelligence Labs (AMI Labs). They have their uses, he says, but will never be able to tackle complicated situations in the real world, like getting a robot to do household chores. "They're not a path towards human level or human-like intelligence, or even animal-like intelligence, because they cannot deal with real world data, they just are not built for that," he tells me on the sidelines of VivaTech, France's leading technology conference. So, Paris-based AMI Labs is busy developing a new type of artificial intelligence not based on the tech behind ChatGPT and its rivals.

news.title: SharkNinja招聘AI产品开发高级总监
news.snippet: 小家电巨头招募Sr. Director负责构建统一Data Infrastructure，部署AI工具并推动Product Excellence数字化转型战略实施。
news.raw_snippet: Build unified data infrastructure, deploy AI tools, reform program management, scale AI-powered quality and consumer insights, and lead an embedded AI Fellows team to drive adoption, measurable outcomes, and organizational change across hardware and consumer product lifecycles. SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people's lives in homes around the world. This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of AI, product development, product quality, and organizational transformation. You will own the strategy and execution of AI integration across both SharkNinja's Product Development (PD) and Product Excellence (PE) organizations -- spanning the full product lifecycle from category strategy and conception through launch, and extending into consumer insights, product integrity, process quality, and manufacturing engineering. You report directly to the VP, Chief of Staff to the CEO, with a dotted line to both the Chief Product Officer and the EVP of Product Excellence.
